planets.name: TOI-1772 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1772 with a 8.05-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1772 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1772. Its orbit and size follow Crossfield et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
